title: Пинг-понг
adaptations: Responsive canvas and corrected scaled touch coordinates
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru" file=index.html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
body,html{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif}
#c{background:#111;display:block;margin:auto}
canvas{width:min(98vw,800px);height:auto;touch-action:none}</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'), ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
const W=cv.width, H=cv.height;
const P_W=10, P_H=100, BALL_R=8;
let player={x:20,y:H/2-P_H/2,w:P_W,h:P_H}, ai={x:W-30,y:H/2-P_H/2,w:P_W,h:P_H};
let ball={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:4,vy:2,r:BALL_R};
let pScore=0,aScore=0,gameOver=false,msg='';

function reset(){
  ball.x=W/2;ball.y=H/2;
  ball.vx=4*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);
  ball.vy=2*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);
  player.y=H/2-P_H/2; ai.y=H/2-P_H/2;
  gameOver=false;msg='';
}
function draw(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h);
  ctx.fillRect(ai.x,ai.y,ai.w,ai.h);
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();
  ctx.font='20px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`${pScore} : ${aScore}`,W/2-20,30);
  if(msg){ctx.fillText(msg,W/2-70, H/2);}
}
function update(){
  if(gameOver) return;
  ball.x+=ball.vx; ball.y+=ball.vy;
  if(ball.y<ball.r||ball.y>H-ball.r) ball.vy=-ball.vy;
  // player paddle collision
  if(ball.x-ball.r<player.x+player.w && ball.y>player.y && ball.y<player.y+player.h){
    ball.vx=-ball.vx; ball.x=player.x+player.w+ball.r;
  }
  // AI paddle collision
  if(ball.x+ball.r>ai.x && ball.y>ai.y && ball.y<ai.y+ai.h){
    ball.vx=-ball.vx; ball.x=ai.x-ball.r;
  }
  // scoring
  if(ball.x<0){aScore++; checkWin();}
  if(ball.x>W){pScore++; checkWin();}
  // AI movement
  if(ai.y+ai.h/2<ball.y) ai.y+=4;
  else if(ai.y+ai.h/2>ball.y) ai.y-=4;
  ai.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(H-ai.h,ai.y));
}
function checkWin(){
  if(pScore===5||aScore===5){
    gameOver=true;
    msg=(pScore===5?'Вы победили!':'Победа компьютера!');
    setTimeout(()=>{pScore=0;aScore=0;reset();},2000);
  }else reset();
}
function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
canvasRect=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
function setPlayer(y){
  player.y=y-P_H/2;
  player.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(H-P_H,player.y));
}
cv.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>setPlayer((e.clientY-cv.getBoundingClientRect().top)*H/cv.getBoundingClientRect().height));
cv.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{e.preventDefault(); setPlayer((e.touches[0].clientY-cv.getBoundingClientRect().top)*H/cv.getBoundingClientRect().height);}, {passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='ArrowUp') setPlayer(player.y);
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown') setPlayer(player.y+P_H);
  if(e.key==='ArrowUp') player.y=Math.max(0,player.y-10);
  if(e.key==='ArrowDown') player.y=Math.min(H-P_H,player.y+10);
});
reset(); loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
